text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. List of academic/research productions Give in details, if any. 8. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.
